author: "Zhang Lab"
description: >
  The Poultry Science Association named Dr. Li Zhang the recipient of its 2026
  Early Achievement Award for Research, presented at the PSA Annual Meeting in
  Toronto.
categories: [Awards]
---

The Poultry Science Association has recognized **Dr. Li Zhang** with its **2026
Early Achievement Award for Research**, one of the association's professional
awards honoring early-career contributions to poultry science. PSA
[announced the 2026 recipients](https://www.poultryscience.org/blogs/communication-psa/2026/07/07/poultry-science-association-announces-2026-award-r?CommunityKey=c2337693-276b-4750-91cd-018d8982698a)
on July 7, and the awards were presented during the Awards Celebration at the
PSA Annual Meeting in Toronto, Ontario, on July 12.

In its announcement, PSA highlighted the lab's research program in
agricultural microbiomics — combining microbial genomics, rapid diagnostics,
microbiome science, and animal models to improve poultry health and food
safety from farm to fork, with an emphasis on avian pathogenic *E. coli*,
*Campylobacter*, *Salmonella*, and *Clostridium perfringens*. The citation also
noted more than $3.2 million in research funding as PI and co-PI, over 60
peer-reviewed publications, service as a Section Editor for *Poultry Science*,
and the mentoring of 14 graduate students and 6 postdoctoral researchers.

Mississippi State was recognized twice in the early-career category this year:
Dr. Timothy Boltz, a departmental colleague and collaborator, received the PSA
Early Achievement Award in Teaching.

An award like this belongs to everyone who has worked in the lab. Thank you to
our students and postdocs, past and present, and to our collaborators at
Mississippi State, USDA ARS, and across the poultry industry.
